hero.title: Clarity for your next step
hero.subtitle: A space to reflect, understand, and choose with more confidence. Tarot and astrology for real-life decisions — relationships, career, transitions, and self-awareness.

intro.title: Tarot and astrology as tools for reflection
intro.body: Your reading is not a fixed prediction. It is a space for perspective — a way to see patterns, weigh possibilities, and make conscious choices. Sessions are warm, direct, and practical, never deterministic or fear-based.

steps.title: Choose your session
steps.body: Pick the format that fits your moment — a focused audio reading or a deep online session.

steps.title: Share your context
steps.body: Tell us your questions and your birth details, so your astrological information can be prepared accurately.

steps.title: Receive your reading
steps.body: Audio readings arrive via WhatsApp; deep sessions happen live online. Always with care and honesty.

birth.title: Why we ask for your birth details
birth.body: Your birth date, birth time, and birth city are required to prepare your astrological information accurately. They are stored securely, used only for your readings, and can be exported or deleted at your request.

services.title: Sessions
services.subtitle: Choose the space your question needs.

footer.disclaimer: Readings are intended for reflection and self-awareness and do not replace medical, psychological, legal, or financial advice.
